text:
marta: Hey infra team — new tenant onboarding for account 123456789012 in eu-west-12. Need accelerator + networking ceilings raised so we can provision p5 instances and a small warm pool. Specifically asking: p5 quota 8 -> 32, p4d quota 0 -> 8, g5 quota 16 -> 64, and ENI limit bumped for the VPC (we're seeing ENI shortage for large instance types). Also need ~10 additional EIPs and a natgw throughput check. Can someone kick off the AWS case?

josh: Ack. Quick checklist: has VPC subnet sizes been validated? large instance counts need /20 or larger for IPs if we plan 30+ nodes.

marta: Subnets are /20 in the target AZs, but we want to be safe — will also request IPv6 fallback in case ENI/EIP NAT caps hit.

leo: I'll draft the Service Quotas request. AWS sometimes rejects p5/p4d unless you note HVM and ENI needs. Also we should attach expected monthly hours to justify.

sam: FYI cost question — p5s will be expensive. Do we want a canary with g5s first and fall back to p5 only for latency-sensitive routes?

marta: Good call. We'll plan canary on g5 x 2 and scale to p5 once SLA validated. But quota lift needs to allow immediate p5 capacity for smoke tests.

leo: Draft for AWS Support case (paste into console):

```
Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-12
Request: Increase Accelerator and Networking quotas to support production inference.
- p5 (accelerator) quota: current 8 -> request 32
- p4d (accelerator) quota: current 0 -> request 8
- g5 (accelerator) quota: current 16 -> request 64
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) soft limit: increase by 500 across subnets
- Elastic IPs (EIP): request +10
- NAT Gateway throughput review and guidance for high-connection workloads
Reason: Redwood Inference onboarding for new enterprise tenant. Expected steady-state: 18 p5 instances + burst for training/inference and 40 g5 for canary/traffic shaping. Monthly committed hours: ~30,000 (we are an enterprise customer). Please escalate to the accelerators team if automatic quotas do not apply. Contact: marta@redwood.ai, TAM: Redwood_Sales_TAM
```

leo: I'll file and cc josh. Will also include our expected ASN and VPC ids.

infra-bot: quota-checker: detected potential ENI saturation in eu-west-12 for account 123456789012 — recommend requesting ENI pool increase before provisioning more instances. (link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=eu-west-12)

josh: When you open case, include the resource ARNs and sample instance types (p5.24xlarge, p4d.24xlarge, g5.12xlarge). AWS usually wants exact instance family.

marta: Filed support case #987654321 with the draft above and linked our VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f. AWS auto-reply says expected response 48-72h but requested expedited review.

leo: Added cost & usage justification doc to the case and asked TAM to route to capacity team. Also asked for a cross-account placement note — we may need fallback to eu-west-11 if capacity constrained.

sam: Thanks. For rollout plan: 1) provision 2 g5 canaries, 2) smoke tests + perf profile, 3) scale to p5 up to 4, 4) scale to full 18 after SLA ok. Keep me posted on cost vs perf.

marta: Will update thread when case moves. If anybody notices pending instance launches failing with "Insufficient capacity" in eu-west-12, tag @marta and paste the error logs.

leo: Also flagging network team to validate NAT GW and route table throughput — large model shards open many connections.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: posted quota request snapshot to #incidents for visibility.

marta: Closing loop — added ticket link and documents to tenant onboarding board. Will re-open if AWS asks for more info. Thanks all :thumbsup:
